integrity: Full infinite proof is given; finite script checks are diagnostics and not a substitute for the proof. Primary bibliographic comparison uses inspected papers and a prior accessible statement whose complete text was unavailable.
scientific_limitations: For any two distinct primes and positive integer inputs only; no assertions for three or more primes, rational periodicity, or arbitrary orbit convergence. Prior single-pair case and general fixed-point equation acknowledged; unindexed covering work remains possible.
title: No nontrivial positive cycles for two-prime arithmetic subderivatives
